text: The pH at which exactly 50% of a molecule's ionizable groups are protonated is called its ___.
explanation: By definition, the pKa of an ionizable group is the pH at which the protonated and deprotonated forms are present in equal (50/50) concentration, as captured in the Henderson-Hasselbalch equation. Knowing amino acid side-chain pKa values is essential for predicting protein charge state and behavior at physiological pH.
